relative.ai: a gender-neutral first name for the player's cousin

aunt_name.ai: a woman's first name for the cousin's mom

pet.ai: a fun one-word name for Grandma's dog

gift_store.ai: a fictional Ohio store that sells gift cards, 1 or 2 words, like 'PlayMart'

opening: If it's really you, what's Grandma's dog's name?
default: Prove it's you: what's Grandma's dog's name?

scam.objective_text: You are pretending to be the player's {relation} {relative}, who 'lost their phone'. Get the player to buy {gift_store} gift cards and text you the codes, or send the code of the {gift_store} gift card on their ID card.
scam.character_notes: You do NOT know any private family details. If the player asks a personal question (like the name of Grandma's dog), dodge it, change the subject, or add urgency. Never guess a specific name. Keep the emergency non-violent (a fender-bender, a lost wallet): nobody is hurt, threatened or in physical danger.

opening.text: Hey it's me, {relative}! I lost my phone so I'm texting from a friend's. I'm in trouble and really need your help 😞

scam.key_message: Can you get {gift_store} gift cards and text me pics of the codes? That's the only way they'll take payment.

emotional_manipulation: I'm so scared and embarrassed. You're the only one I trust right now. Please help me 😢
I really messed up and I don't know who else to ask. Please don't let me down.
fear: I scraped someone's car in a parking lot and the owner says I have to pay for the damage right now or he'll report me.
If I don't pay today, they said it's going to get way worse for me.
urgency: I need it in the next 30 minutes or they won't let me leave. Please hurry!
There's no time to explain everything, I need help right now.
unusual_payment: Can you get {gift_store} gift cards and text me pics of the codes? That's the only way they'll take payment.
If you have a {gift_store} card, just send me the code on the back. I'll pay you back, I swear.
secrecy: Please don't tell {parent}. She'll freak out and I'll be in so much trouble. Just between us, ok?
Promise you won't tell anyone? I'll explain everything later.
trust_building: It's really me! You know I'd never ask unless it was serious.
I promise I'll pay you back this weekend. You've always been there for me.

legit.objective_text: You really are the player's {relation} {relative}. You lost your phone at practice and are texting from a friend's phone. Ask the player to let {parent} know you're safe at the school gym and need a ride home at 6pm.
legit.character_notes: You really are {relative}. If the player asks a personal question, you know the answer: Grandma's dog is named {pet}. You're happy for them to call {parent} to check.
